name: @promopilot/serp-preview
description: Preview Google search snippets from the command line: measures titles and meta descriptions in pixels with Arial metrics, shows the truncation point for desktop and mobile, and flags missing, generic or cut-off snippets. Works on live URLs or plain text, with an HTML preview export. Zero-dependency Node.js CLI, library and GitHub Action. Free online version by PromoPilot.
author: Alexandr Krikun (https://github.com/ksanyok)
